idea-plugin.name: Firmware Release Gate
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the build-config lines that ship an ESP-IDF or Zephyr device with secure boot off, a debug port open, unsigned images or plaintext OTA.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Firmware Release Gate: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 18 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/firmware-release-gate (Node.js 18+ required).

Free: check the file you open — every finding on its line, with the fix.
Pro (JetBrains Marketplace licence): Tools → Firmware Release Gate: Check Whole Project sweeps every matching file in the project and writes a dated HTML and CSV report you can attach to a review or an audit.

Web version and rule list: getreadystack.com/tools/firmware-release-gate
